# Bihar Aur Purnea Maize Market Report — 10 May 2026 (Ravivaar/Sunday)

## Aaj Ka Haal — Mandi Band Hai Lekin Khabar Bahut Zaroori Hai

Kisan bhai, aaj Sunday hai — mandi band hai. Lekin kal (Monday, 11 May) mandi khulte hi jo daam milega woh aaj ke haal se tay hoga. Isliye aaj ki khabar bahut zaroori hai.

**Purnea Mandi Ka Daam:**
Purnea (Bihar) ki Gulabbagh mandi — jo Asia ka sabse bada makka ka trading center hai — mein aaj makka (maize) ka daam ₹2,037 per quintal (100 kilo) chal raha hai. 1 May ko yeh ₹1,960 tha — matlab 9 dino mein ₹77 ki tezi aayi hai! Yeh tezi Iran ki ladai (Strait of Hormuz band hone se tel mehnga — $101 per barrel) aur India ke net importer banne se aayi hai.

**April 1 Se Aaj Tak Ka Safar:**
Humari pichli report April 1 ki thi — tab daam ₹1,912 tha. Aaj ₹2,037 hai — yani ₹125 ki badhaaT 39 dino mein. Yeh un logon ke liye buri khabar hai jo April mein bechne ki jagah ruk gaye the — unhone theek kiya!

**NCDEX Ka Bada Khatara:**
NCDEX (Delhi mein ek bada sarkari bazaar jahan aage ke mahine ka makka ka daam tay hota hai — jaise gaon ka mukhia future ka niyam banata hai) mein May 2026 ka contract ₹1,907 par hai. Yeh Purnea ke ₹2,037 se ₹130 NEECHE hai. Yeh ek bahut bada khatra hai — kyunki yeh contract 20 May ko khatam hoga. Jab contract khatam hota hai toh mandi ka daam aur NCDEX ka daam bahut paas aa jaate hain. Matlab: Purnea ka daam ₹1,907 ke aas paas aane ka khatara hai — ₹130 ki girawat 10 dino mein!

**Bihar Mein Rabi Fasal Ki Aawaak:**
Bihar ki mandis mein abhi bhi rabi (sardi ki) makka aa rahi hai — yeh peak arrivals (sabse zyada maal aane ka waqt, April 5 se May 15 tak) ka aakhri dor hai. 15 May se tapering (dheere-dheere kam hona) shuru hogi. Lekin abhi tak bahut maal aa raha hai — jis wajah se NCDEX daam dabaav mein hai. Bihar mein is saal pichle saal se 15% zyada makka paidawar hui — yeh bearish (daam girne wali) khabar hai.

**Sarkar Ka Tay Kiya Daam vs Mandi:**
Sarkar ne MSP (Minimum Support Price — matlab minimum floor daam) ₹2,400 per quintal tay kiya hai. Lekin mandi mein ₹2,037 chal raha hai — ₹363 per quintal ka SEEDHA NUKSAN! Sarkar kharidi (procurement) nahi kar rahi — kisan ko open market mein hi bechna padta hai.

**El Nino Ka Naya Khatara:**
IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka mausam vibhag) ne bataya hai ki is saal ka barsaat ka mausam (Monsoon 2026) normal se KAM hoga — sirf 92% of normal. Yeh El Nino (ek Pacific Ocean mein garam pani ki lahren jis se India mein kam baarish hoti hai) ki wajah se. Iska matlab: Kharif 2026 (June-July mein boye jaane wale) makka ki fasal ko nuksan ho sakta hai — future supply kam hogi. Yeh ek medium-term bullish (daam badhane wali) khabar hai.

**Aaj Bihar Ka Mausam:**
IMD ne aaj Bihar ke liye Orange alert (darje ka mausam intazaar) jaari kiya hai — tez aandhi (80-85 km/ghante ki hawa), baarish aur bijli ka asar. Yeh kal (Monday) mandi mein makka ki supply rokne ka kaam karega — thodi zyada demand aur kam supply matlab daam thoda support milega.

America ki sarkar ki farming report (WASDE — duniya ke khane ki supply-demand ki monthly report) 12 May ko aayegi — 2 din mein. Is mein Brazil, Argentina, aur duniya ka makka ka estimate hoga. Agar Brazil mein zyada makka bataya (CONAB ke 139.6 MMT ke paas, USDA ke 125 MMT se zyada) toh global daam aur girnge — India ka daam bhi neeche jaayega.

**Agle 10 Din Ka Anumaan:**
Aaj ₹2,037 se chalu hokar 19 May tak ₹1,959 tak aane ka anumaan hai — ₹78 ki girawat. Sabse tez girawat 11-14 May ke beech hogi. 15 May ke baad rabi arrivals tapering (dheemi hona) shuroo honge toh girawat thodi kam hogi. NCDEX contract 20 May ko khatam hoga — tab bade convergence pressure se spot daam aur neeche aa sakta hai.

news_items.title: India pehli baar maize ka net importer bana — America, South Africa, Ukraine se maal aa raha hai — daam ko ek floor (neeche ki seema) mila
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** India, jo pehle makka ka EXPORTER (bahar bechne wala) tha, ab NET IMPORTER (bahar se khareedne wala) ban gaya hai. America (29%), South Africa (27%), aur Ukraine (19%) se makka aaya. Yeh ek bada structural (buniyaadi structure mein badlav) change hai.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** 'Net importer' matlab jab desh apni zaroorat se zyada bahar se khareedta hai. Pehle India makka export karta tha — zyada makka bikti bahar. Ab E20 mandate (petrol mein 20% sharab milana) aur poultry (murgi-palan) ki badh rahi zaroorat ki wajah se India khud apne se zyada kha raha hai. Iska seedha matlab: India mein makka ki demand zyada hogi local supply se. Isse ek 'import parity floor' (ek neeche ki seema) banta hai — agar daam bahut neeche gaya toh bahar se mangaana mehnga padta hai toh domestic daam uss se neeche nahi ja sakta.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Yeh ek acha sign hai kisan ke liye — daam ek level se bahut neeche nahi jaayenge. Import parity floor (bahar se mangaane ki cost) lagbhag ₹1,850-₹1,900 per quintal hoti hai — toh Purnea ka daam probably usse neeche nahi girega.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Is khabar se mat baho — abhi bhi JALDI BECHO. ₹2,037 accha price hai. ₹1,850 floor hai lekin abhi ₹2,037 mil raha hai — kyun wait karoge?
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: ₹1,900 ke aas paas ek achha entry point milega — May 20 ke baad dekhna.

news_items.title: Argentina ka record maize harvest — 58-62 MMT — aur Brazil 125-139 MMT — duniya mein makka ka dher — America ka May WASDE 12 May ko
news_items.category: International — Duniya Ki Supply Bahut Zyada
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Argentina (South America ka bada desh) mein is saal makka ki record paidawar aayi — 58-62 MMT (Million Metric Tonnes — 5.8 se 6.2 crore tonne — bahut bada dher). Brazil mein bhi 125-139 MMT makka. Upar se America ki sarkar ka WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — duniya ke khane ki supply-demand ki monthly report) 12 May ko aayegi — 2 din mein.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** 'MMT' matlab Million Metric Tonnes — ek MMT = 10 lakh tonne. Argentina ka 62 MMT matlab 62 lakh crore kilo makka — bahut bada dher. Jab duniya mein itna makka hoga toh sab desh saste daam par khareed sakte hain. India bhi import karne ki zyada jagah bana sakta hai. Brazil mein USDA (America ka Krishi Mantralaya) ka estimate 125 MMT hai lekin CONAB (Brazil ki apni agency) ka estimate 139.6 MMT hai — ₹14.6 MMT ka antar! Agar May 12 ki WASDE mein USDA ne Brazil ko 132+ MMT diya toh global supply bahut zyada hogi — bearish.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Duniya mein itna makka hai toh India ko bhi khatra hai ki koi bade factory wale ya poultry wale sochenge — 'zaroorat padi toh bahar se le lenge.' Yeh ek indirect downward pressure (daam girne ka pressure) banata hai India mein. WASDE 12 May ko aayegi — us din Purnea daam ₹10-15 aur gir sakta hai agar bear data aaya.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: 12 May se PEHLE becho — WASDE ke baad daam neeche jaayega. Kal (Monday) bhi becho, parson (Tuesday, 12 May) subah WASDE release se pehle becho.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: 12 May ke baad WASDE data dekhkar kharido — sasta ho sakta hai.

news_items.title: Maize ban gaya India ka Number 1 ethanol feedstock — 48% share — E20 shuru, AIDA E30 maang raha hai 2028 tak
news_items.category: Ethanol Structural Demand — Makka Ka Pukka Khareedaar
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** AIDA (All India Distillers Association — poore India ki sharab-banane wali factories ki badi sanstha) ne announce kiya ki makka (maize) ab India ka Number 1 'feedstock' (kachcha maal jisse sharab/ethanol banta hai) ban gaya hai — poore ethanol supply ka 48% hissa ab makka se aa raha hai. E20 (petrol mein 20% sharab milaana) April 1 se shuru ho gaya. AIDA ne E30 (30% sharab) ki maang 2028-30 tak ki hai.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** 'Ethanol feedstock' matlab woh cheez jisse alcohol banta hai. Pehle India mein zyada sharab ganne (sugarcane — jisse cheeni banti hai) se banti thi. Ab makka 48% hissa le chuka hai. India ki distillery capacity 20 billion liters hai — E20 ke liye 11 billion liters chahiye. Baaki 9 billion liters extra capacity baith rahi hai. Agar E30 aaya toh yeh extra capacity bhi kaam aayegi — aur maize ki demand bahut badhegi. Yeh ek long-term bullish (daam badhane wali) khabar hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Makka ka ek pukka permanent khareedaar — distillery wale — ab guarantee hai. E20 ke baad se woh dheere-dheere har mahine khareedenge. E30 aaya toh 2028-30 mein aur zyada demand hogi. Yeh ek 'demand floor' (daam ko ek neeche ki seema) deta hai kisan ke liye.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Abhi bhi jaldi becho — structural demand achhi hai lekin abhi arrivals ki wajah se daam dabaav mein hain.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Ethanol demand strong hai — yeh ek long-term bullish factor hai. October-November mein kharidna ek achi planning hogi.

news_items.title: India-US ka DDGS deal — FSSAI ka GM-free rule rok raha hai — 5 lakh tonne quota bahut kam use hua — murgi-walon ki maize demand safe abhi
news_items.category: India-US Trade / DDGS — Murgi Chaara Import
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** February 7, 2026 ke India-US interim trade deal mein America se 5 lakh tonne DDGS (makka se alcohol banaane ke baad jo baccha hua chaara hota hai — murgi, machhli, bhed-bakri ko khilaate hain) bina ya kum duty par aane ki baat thi. Lekin FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India — India ki khaane ki safety janch karne wali sanstha) ka ek sakhta niyam hai ki GM-free (genetically modified se free — matlab lab mein badla gaya beej nahi hona chahiye) certificate dena padega. America ka DDGS GM makka se banta hai — toh yeh certificate nahi milta. Toh bahut kam DDGS aaya abhi tak.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** 'GM crops' matlab Genetically Modified — woh fasal jiske beej lab mein change kiye gaye. America mein zyatsar makka GM hai — yah India mein abhi allowed nahi hai khaane ke liye. DDGS ka matlab 'Distillers Dried Grains with Solubles' — makka se alcohol banaane ke baad jo baccha hua sukhaa chaara hota hai. Agar DDGS India mein aata toh murgi wale aur machhli wale makka ki jagah yeh sasta chaara khareedenge — seedha makka ki demand kam hogi. Lekin FSSAI ka niyam rok raha hai — toh abhi koi bada fark nahi.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Abhi koi direct asar nahi — makka ki murgi-walon ki demand safe hai. Lekin agar FSSAI ne kabhi clearance di toh big risk hai. Watch list par rakho.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Abhi toh koi fark nahi — yeh niyam hata nahi hai.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: FSSAI news par nazar rakhna — clearance aayi toh daam gir sakta hai.

news_items.title: IMD ka Orange alert — Bihar mein aaj tez aandhi 80-85 kmph aur baarish — mandi kal thodi support milegi, arrivals rukenge

news_items.explanation:

Patna mein 33 degree temperature aur 'patchy rain nearby.' Purnea aur North Bihar mein bhi thunderstorm (aandhi-toofan) expected.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Jab itni tez aandhi aati hai (80-85 kmph — matlab bullet train se bhi tez hawa) toh kisan apna makka khet mein chhod ke ghar mein baith jaata hai. Aur mandi mein maal lane ki gaadi bhi nahi chalti. Iska matlab: kal (Monday, 11 May) mandi mein nayi rabi makka ki supply thodi kam rahegi — agar supply kam hogi toh daam thoda upar rehega ya kam neeche girega. Yeh ek temporary (kuch dino ka) support hai daam ke liye.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Aaj aur kal (Sunday-Monday) ke liye yeh ek chhoti si achhi khabar hai — mandi mein supply thodi rukegi, daam thoda support milega. Lekin yeh sirf 1-2 din ka effect hai — uske baad phir regular arrivals shuroo honge.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Kal mausam thoda saaf hote hi mandi jaao — jab supply thodi kam hogi toh better price milega. Lekin zyada wait mat karo.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Aaj ya kal thoda wait karo — supply rukne se kal thoda mehnga milega, parson phir saste mein milega.

video_news.description: Yeh video 4 April 2026 ka Bihar maize mandi bhav batata hai — tab peak arrivals (sabse zyada nayi fasal mandi mein aana) shuru ho rahi thi aur daam ₹1,870-1,910 range mein tha. video_news.title: Kya Ethanol India ko $4 Billion tel-import se bacha sakta hai? E20 aur India ka fuel future — Upstox

video_news.description: Upstox (ek bada stock market platform) ne yeh video banaya hai jisme samjhaya ki E20 (petrol mein 20% sharab milana) India ko kitna paisa bachayega — $4 billion (400 crore dollar) har saal! Makka se banane wali ethanol ka 48% hissa ab India ke ethanol supply mein hai. E30 aaya toh aur $4-5 billion bachega. video_news.title: PM Kisan Yojana ki 22vi kist Bihar ke kisanon ke liye — poori jaankari

video_news.title: Bihar mein makka ki paidawar 15% zyada — iGrain ki report — Purnea, Begusarai, Samastipur mein nayi fasal
video_news.description: iGrain India (ek badi krishi jaankari company — jo data collect karke batati hai ki kitni fasal hogi aur kahan) ne bataya ki Bihar mein is saal makka ki paidawar (production — kitna makka ugaya) pichle saal se 15% ZYADA hoga. Purnea, Khagaria, Begusarai, Samastipur, Darbhanga APMC mandis mein nayi rabi makka (sardi ki fasal) aana shuru ho gayi hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: 15% zyada maal matlab mandi mein zyada aawak — jab zyada maal aata hai toh daam girte hain — bilkul waise jaise ek hi gaon mein sab ek din aam laayenge toh daam toot jaata hai.

video_news.title: India ab maize ka net importer ban gaya — America, South Africa, Ukraine se maal aa raha hai — structural change
video_news.description: Drishti IAS (ek bada educational news platform) ne report kiya ki India, jo pehle makka bahar bechta tha (exporter), ab bahar se khareedne wala (net importer) ban gaya hai. E20 mandate ke liye ethanol demand, poultry industry ki growth aur starch processing industry ki zaroorat ne India ki maize demand domestic supply se zyada kar di. America, South Africa aur Ukraine se 656+ shipments (pani ke jahaaz se) aaye. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh ek acha sign hai — iska matlab daam bahut neeche nahi jaayenge kyunki bahar se mangaana bhi ek seema se neeche sasta nahi padta.

video_news.title: Makka #1 ethanol feedstock ban gaya India mein — 48% share — AIDA E30 maang raha hai 2028 tak — kisan ke liye long term acchi khabar
video_news.description: ChiniMandi (shakar aur biofuel industry ki news website) ne AIDA (All India Distillers Association — poore India ki sharab banane wali factories ki sanstha) ka announcement diya. Makka ab India ka Number 1 ethanol feedstock (kachcha maal jisse sharab banta hai) ban gaya — 48% share. Grain-based distilleries (makka aur chawal se sharab banane wali factories) ne is saal 13,040 million liter ethanol supply ki. AIDA E30 (30% ethanol) ki maang kar rahi hai 2028-30 tak. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh bahut achha long term sign hai — makka ki demand permanently strong rahegi aage bhi.

video_news.title: May WASDE 12 May ko — Argentina 62 MMT record harvest — global makka ka bada dher — daam par dabaav
video_news.description: DTN Progressive Farmer (America ki badi krishi news website) ne bataya ki 12 May ko WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — duniya ke khane ki supply-demand ki America ki government report) aayegi. Is mein Argentina ka 58-62 MMT record harvest (sabse zyada kabhi ugaya) dikhaya jaayega. Brazil ka estimate 125-133.7 MMT (USDA) vs 139.6 MMT (CONAB — Brazil ki apni agency). Duniya ka ending stock (saal ke ant mein bachaa hua stok) 296.5 MMT hoga. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh report 12 May ko aayegi — us din Purnea mandi mein ₹10-15 aur girawat ho sakti hai agar data bearish (zyada supply) raha.

video_news.title: El Nino 2026 — IMD ne kaha Monsoon 92% of normal — kharif maize ki fasal ko khatra — October mein daam badhenge
video_news.description: Down To Earth (ek badi environment aur science news website) ne IMD ka April 2026 monsoon forecast bataya. El Nino (Pacific Ocean mein garam pani ki lehren jo India mein baarish kam karti hai) ki wajah se is saal ka barsaat ka mausam sirf 92% of normal hoga. Kharif maize (June-July mein boyi wali fasal) ko zyada baarish chahiye — agar 8% kam baarish hui toh paidawar 5-10% gir sakti hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh 5-6 mahine baad ki khabar hai — abhi bhi rabi makka becho, lekin kharif season mein zyada poori mehnat karo aur irrigation (seenchne) ka intezaam rakho.

video_news.title: Bihar mein aaj 10 May ko tez aandhi aur baarish — 80-85 kmph ki hawa — mandi kal thodi slow rahegi
video_news.description: DNP India (ek news website) ne aaj ka mausam bataya — Bihar mein severe storms (bahut tez toofan) expected hain. 80-85 km per ghante (yeh bahut tez hawa hai — jaise bullet train jaati hai uss se bhi tez) ki hawa aur baarish. IMD ka orange alert jaari hai. Iska matlab kal (Monday, 11 May) mandi mein makka laaana mushkil hoga — supply thodi kam rahegi jo temporarily daam ko support dega. Kisan bhai ke liye: kal mausam thoda saaf hone par mandi jaao — thoda zyada price mil sakta hai agar supply kam rahi.

video_news.title: Iran ki ladai aur Strait of Hormuz — 20% duniya ka tel ruka — Brent $101 — maize ki ethanol demand zyada
video_news.description: Wikipedia par Iran ki ladai (February 28, 2026 se shuru — America aur Israel ne Iran par hamla kiya) aur Strait of Hormuz (samandar ka ek zaroori rasta jahan se duniya ka 20% tel guzarta tha — ab band hai) ka poora haal likha gaya hai. Brent Crude (duniya ka important tel ka daam) $101 per barrel hai — $90 se upar matlab sarkar ko maize se ethanol BAHUT zaroori lag raha hai. Ceasefire (ladai band karne ka agreement) April 7 ko hua tha lekin tensions abhi bhi hain. Kisan bhai ke liye: jab tak Iran ka tel $90 se upar hai, maize ki ethanol demand zyada rahegi — yeh ek bullish support hai daam ke liye.

video_news.title: Russia-Ukraine Black Sea ceasefire — grain corridor — Ukraine ka makka export phir shuru ho sakta hai — bearish risk
video_news.description: Newsweek ne bataya ki Russia aur Ukraine (jo do saal se ladh rahe hain) ke beech Black Sea (ek samundar — jahan se Ukraine ka anaj export hota hai) ceasefire ki baat ho rahi hai — May 8-9 ko Russia ne 2 din ke liye ceasefire kiya. Agar iska grain corridor (anaj ka aana-jaana wala raasta) phir khul gaya toh Ukraine se maize aur gehu ka export badh sakta hai — global supply zyada hogi — bearish for India. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh ek risk hai — agar Russia-Ukraine ka peace deal hua toh global makka sasta ho sakta hai aur India ka daam bhi thoda gir sakta hai.

video_news.title: AIDA E30 ka roadmap — policy predictability — India distillery industry mein overcapacity — 2028-30 target
video_news.description: AIDA (All India Distillers Association — poore India ki sharab banane wali factories ki sanstha) ki official website par E30 ka roadmap hai. India ki distillery capacity 20 billion liter ho gayi hai — lekin E20 ke liye sirf 11 billion liter chahiye. Baaki 9 billion liter extra baith raha hai. AIDA bol raha hai: E30 laao (30% ethanol petrol mein) toh yeh extra capacity bhi kaam aayegi. E30 aaya toh makka ki demand bahut ZYADA badhegi. Kisan bhai ke liye: 2028-30 mein agar E30 aaya toh aapki makka bahut zyada demand mein hogi — abhi se planning karo kharif mein zyada ugaane ki.

sellers.alternative: Agar aapki makka ki quality bahut achhi hai (moisture — nami — 12% se kam, koi mold nahi, seedha yellow colour) aur storage aapke ghar mein bilkul free hai, toh maximum 10-15% maal May 20-25 ke baad rakh sakte ho — agar Iran-ceasefire deal bigadta hai aur tel phir $110+ par aata hai toh ek chhota bounce ho sakta hai. Lekin yeh ek speculative (andaza wali) bet hai — 85-90% maal KAL hi becho. Risk: agar peace deal hua aur tel $80 gaya toh ₹1,900 bhi nahi milega.

bearish: NCDEX (Delhi ka bada sarkari fasal bazaar — jaise mukhia jo aage ka daam tay karta hai) mein May 2026 ka contract ₹1,907 par chal raha hai — aaj ke Purnea daam ₹2,037 se poore ₹130 NEECHE. Yeh ek bahut bada khatarnak sign hai. Kyun? Kyunki May 20 ko yeh contract expire hoga — aur jab contract expire hota hai toh mandi ka daam aur NCDEX ka daam MILNE PADTE HAIN (convergence — dono ek jagah milte hain). Matlab: ya toh NCDEX ₹2,037 upar aayega (nahi hoga — NCDEX mein 'Sell' signal hai) ya Purnea ₹1,907 neeche aayega (yahi hoga). ₹130 ki gap band hone ke liye ₹130 ki girawat! BEARISH signal No. 1.

Bihar ki mandis mein abhi bhi PEAK ARRIVALS (sabse zyada nayi rabi makka ka mandi mein aana) chal rahi hai — April 5 se May 15 tak. Is season mein Bihar mein pichle saal se 15% ZYADA makka paidawar (production) hui. Matlab 15% zyada maal mandi mein — wahi khareedaar. Aise samjho: ek mela mein 10 dukandaar the pichle saal, is saal 11.5 hain — sab ek hi cheez bech rahe hain — toh sab ko sasta karna pada. Tapering 15 May se shuroo hogi — par tab bhi maal aata rahega. SABSE BADA BEARISH factor hai.

Argentina (South America ka bada desh — jaise India ke liye Pakistan ek pados wala desh hai waisi tarah America ka pados wala makka desh hai) mein is saal makka ki RECORD paidawar aayi — 58 se 62 MMT (Million Metric Tonnes — matlab 5.8 se 6.2 crore tonne — bahut bada dher). Brazil mein bhi 125-139 MMT. Duniya mein ending stocks (saal ke ant mein bachaa hua stok) 296.5 MMT hoga. Duniya mein itna makka pada hai toh India mein bhi bahar se aana aasaan — domestic daam par downward pressure padta hai. BEARISH hai.

MSP (Minimum Support Price — sarkar ka tay kiya hua minimum floor daam) ₹2,400 per quintal hai. Purnea mandi mein aaj ₹2,037 chal raha hai — ₹363 per quintal ka SEEDHA NUKSAN. Matlab ₹100 ki cheez ₹85 mein bik rahi hai — ₹15 ka loss! Aur sarkar khud kharidi (procurement) nahi kar rahi — koi sarkari agency mandi mein nahi aa rahi khareedne ke liye. October 2025 se lekar May 2026 tak — lagbhag 7 mahine se market lagatar MSP ke NEECHE chal rahi hai. Yeh structural oversupply (bahut zyada maal, kam zaroorat) ka ek saaf sanket hai. BEARISH.

America ki WASDE report (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — ek monthly report jisme duniya ka kitna makka hai yeh bataya jaata hai — jaise hamare gaon ka sarpanch saal bhar ka hisaab kitaab karta hai) 12 May (2 din mein) aayegi. Isme Argentina ka 62 MMT record, Brazil ka 132+ MMT, aur India ki sharply zyada production dikhayegi. Is bearish global data ki wajah se 12 May ko daam ₹10-15 aur gir sakta hai. Market 12 May se PEHLE bhi is expectation se daam neeche karta hai. UPCOMING BEARISH event.

India-US ke beech 5 lakh tonne DDGS (makka se alcohol banaane ke baad jo baccha hua chaara hota hai — murgi machhli ko khilaate hain) bina ya kum duty par aane ka deal hua tha. FSSAI (khaane ki safety sanstha) ka niyam abhi bhi rok raha hai kyunki America ka DDGS 'GM makka' (lab mein badla gaya beej) se banta hai aur India mein GM ka certificate chahiye. Par kabhi bhi FSSAI clearance aa sakti hai — tab murgi wale makka ki jagah yeh sasta chaara khareedenge — maize demand seedha ₹100-150 neeche aa sakti hai. Yeh ek LATENT (chhupa hua lekin bada) BEARISH risk hai.
bullish: Iran ki ladai (February 28, 2026 se shuru) ki wajah se Strait of Hormuz (samandar ka ek zaroori rasta — 20% duniya ka tel isi se guzarta tha) band hai. Brent Crude (duniya ka important tel ka daam) $101 per barrel hai — matlab $90 se upar. Jab tel itna mehnga hota hai (aur khatra bana rehta hai ki aur mehnga hoga) toh sarkar ko makka se ethanol (sharab — jo petrol mein milai jaati hai) BAHUT zaroori lagti hai — 'very high ethanol urgency' category mein hai. AIDA aur distillery wale makka khareedna band nahi kar sakte — toh daam ko ek support milta hai. Yeh ek bada BULLISH factor hai — jab tak Iran ki ladai chal rahi hai. BULLISH.

Gulabbagh Mandi (Purnea, Bihar) mein 1 May ko ₹1,960 tha — 10 May (aaj) ₹2,037 — 9 dino mein ₹77 ki tezi! Yeh dikha raha hai ki recent momentum (aane wala direction ka signal — jaise pani ka behna) upward (upar ki taraf) raha hai. Khareedaar active the — distilleries, poultry farms. Yeh tezi abhi bhi market mein ek chhoti si positive bhavna banaye hua hai. Haan, yeh tezi ab dheemi hogi ya ulti hogi — lekin abhi ek positive sign hai. MILDLY BULLISH.

India pehli baar maize ka NET IMPORTER (bahar se khareedne wala) ban gaya. America, South Africa, Ukraine se maal aa raha hai. Jab India import karta hai toh domestic daam ke liye ek IMPORT PARITY FLOOR (neeche ki seema — agar daam bahut neeche gaya toh bahar se mangaana bhi itti cost mein nahi hoga) ban jaati hai — lagbhag ₹1,850-₹1,900 per quintal. Matlab Purnea ka daam probably ₹1,850 se neeche nahi jaayega. Yeh ek chhota sa safety net hai kisan ke liye. MILDLY BULLISH.

IMD (India ka mausam vibhag) ne kaha ki is saal ka Monsoon 2026 sirf 92% of normal hoga — El Nino (Pacific Ocean mein garm pani ki lehren) ki wajah. Kharif maize (June-July mein ugayi jaane wali) ko zyada baarish chahiye — 8% kam baarish hui toh paidawar 5-10% kam ho sakti hai October mein. Isse forward market (aage ke mahine ka daam) mein ek bullish expectation ban rahi hai — agle 5-6 mahine baad supply risk hai. Yeh abhi ke 10 din ke liye direct asar nahi — par ek background bullish support deta hai. MEDIUM TERM BULLISH.
neutral: US mein corn (makka) ki boi 38% complete hai — 5-saal ke average se 4% aage. Yeh 'fast planting' ek bearish signal deta hai ki aage US crop bhi zyada hogi. Lekin CBOT mein aaj corn +0.70% upar aaya — thodi recovery. US mein weather mixed hai — kuch jagah frost aur baarish se planting ruki. Overall: US corn ek neutral factor hai abhi ke liye — na bahut bearish na bahut bullish. NEUTRAL.

India-Russia Ukraine ceasefire talks: Russia ne May 8-9 ko 2-din ceasefire declare kiya. Ukraine alag ceasefire. Black Sea grain corridor (samandar ka raasta jahan se Ukraine ka anaj bahar jaata hai) fir khulne ki baat chal rahi hai. Agar yeh khula toh Ukraine se makka export badh sakta hai — global bearish. Lekin abhi talks chal rahi hain — koi pakka result nahi. Is uncertainty ki wajah se: NEUTRAL for now — lekin ek bearish risk watch karo.

Poultry (murgi-palan) industry India mein 7-8% CAGR (Compound Annual Growth Rate — matlab compound tarika se saal ka 7-8% badh rahi hai) se badh rahi hai. Makka murgi ke chaare mein 46% hissa rakhta hai. Starch industry bhi 7.34% CAGR se badh rahi hai. Yeh demand-side factors (makka ki zaroorat) achhe hain. Lekin DDGS import ka khatra bhi hai — agar FSSAI ne clearance di toh murgi-wale DDGS khareedenge. Abhi dono forces ek doosre ko balance kar rahi hain. NEUTRAL factor overall.
